title: cestrum parqui
intro: Cestrum parqui, commonly known as the Parqui or Yellow Cestrum, is a flowering plant species native to South America. The Parqui plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and stress due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Cestrum parqui are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, which may help to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and promote relaxation.
